newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close steady on institutional support.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close steady on institutional support.

text.p: Dhaka stocks recovered early losses to close steady after institutional support propped up buying by small investors, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index rose 0.04 points or 0.003 percent at 1,215.55 on a turnover of 77.3 million taka on Wednesday. Gainers led losers by 76 to 52.
"A profit taking by investors pulled down share prices in early trading, but later the market recovered as institutional support propped up buying by small investors," said one broker.
Aftab Automobiles lost 44 taka to 533, Chittagong Cement rose 36 to 2,345 and Green Delta Insurance was up 26 to 595.
